sent.subject: RE: Port Logistics & Corporate Registration Clearance - ABENTRA Advisory
sent.body:
Dear Mr. Mensah,

Thank you for reaching out to ABENTRA International. We would be pleased to assist West Africa Trading with your subsidiary registration and LRA tax clearance for the Freeport operations.

Our team has prepared a preliminary roadmap. Let us schedule an executive consultation this week.

Warm regards,
Abenetta Kollie
Founder & Managing Director
ABENTRA International
